note: Every path adopt seeds into a project by copying its bytes, tracked in the manifest. A project gets the loop as well as the rules: .claude/skills/ and .claude/commands/ carry pick-work and /work, and docs/roles/ carries one guide per role. An entry ending in / expands to every file under it, so a file landing on another branch joins this list when it lands. The bin/ entries are named one by one because bin/adopt is this template's own tool and does not belong in a project it seeded. template_only subtracts from a directory expansion for that same reason: the adopt skill and the /agentkit command drive bin/adopt, and a project is adopted from an agentkit checkout on a rerun as much as on a first run, so a project needs none of the three. Naming every other skill and command one by one instead would drop one from every project the moment somebody adds one here. design/ is the directory design-process steps 3, 6 and 8 need somewhere to run: the capture writes its two files per screen there, the team layer's file surface names the same path, and a project with no screens gets a directory it never fills, the way it gets three role guides and fills one. per_pack is the second subtraction, and the only one that puts something back: a capture needs a browser driver, the driver a project can install is the one its pack already declares, so the python pack receives design/capture.py and design/build.py, the typescript pack receives design/capture.mjs and design/build.mjs, and neither receives the other pair. The generator needs no browser and would run under either interpreter; it is split anyway because a project rewrites the generator with its own components, and it should have one file to rewrite in the language it already writes. Both generators are held to the same bytes by tests/test_design.py. python+typescript takes the python driver: that pack runs its pnpm gates in web/, so a node driver at the repository root would resolve puppeteer from a node_modules that is not there, and uv run --with playwright needs no install at all. The manifest records the pack, so a rerun that names none seeds the same driver again. CLAUDE.md is absent because a project's router is rendered from adopt's answers rather than copied: this repository's copy describes agentkit, and a project's carries its own name, summary and open questions. .github/workflows/ is absent for a second reason: a tracked file is replaced on every rerun and the project's version moves to a .local sidecar, and GitHub runs no .local, so a project that had tuned its workflow would silently be running this repository's copy. adopt renders both workflows from the pack and seeds them once. probes/ has no directory entry and one file under it is named on its own line. probes/skill_sources.py reads whatever .claude/skills/ holds in the repository it runs in, so it is correct in every project that took the skills, and a project that took them has the URLs they cite and nothing else that checks one is still there. The rest of probes/ reads a GitHub payload, a refero catalogue and a skill loader's roots. Those are interfaces this template touches and a seeded project may never have, and rule 9 asks a project to drop a rule it has no interface for, so they stay here. No workflow comes with the probe: a project runs it by hand or wires its own schedule, because bin/adopt asks nothing about labels and a rendered weekly job would open its issues without any.
